records.Name: Ask an SFCC developer
records.Description__c: Type your SFCC question (SFRA, SCAPI, PWA Kit, Business Manager, jobs, integrations). Piyush replies by email.

records.Name: Resume review for Salesforce / SFCC developers
records.Description__c: Upload your resume as a PDF and get it back with comments on what to cut, sharpen and add for Salesforce and SFCC roles.

records.Name: 20-minute career chat
records.Description__c: A relaxed video call about SFCC careers, switching projects or getting started. Book a slot that suits you.
records.Delivery_Promise__c: Video link sent when you book

records.Name: Mock SFCC interview (45 min)
records.Description__c: A practice interview with SFCC technical questions, followed by written feedback on what went well and what to work on.
